name: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer leaving Northshire, you help protect Elwynn's supply lines and settlements. Goldshire's garrison needs to know when threats gather.
As a hunter, you know a tracking kit can help you follow vermin trails through the woods.

faq.answer: You follow kobolds moving beyond Northshire Valley with a tracking kit. Find where they are gathering, then report what you find to the Stormwind authorities in Goldshire.
faq.q: What is the goal of this task?

faq.answer: Marshal McBride, commander of Northshire Valley, is concerned about the kobolds' movements. A local guide gives you a tracking kit so you can follow their trail out of the valley and into Elwynn Forest.
faq.q: Who is concerned about the kobold movements?

faq.answer: The tracks lead out of Northshire toward Fargodeep Mine in central Elwynn Forest. Kobolds have gathered there in force.
faq.q: Where do the kobold tracks lead?

faq.answer: Marshal Dughan commands the Stormwind guard garrison in Goldshire. He coordinates Elwynn Forest's local defenses and receives reports of threats moving into the region.
Fargodeep Mine is already infested with kobolds. More of them heading there means greater danger for local workers and nearby settlements.
faq.q: Why are the kobolds heading to Fargodeep Mine?

faq.answer: When you report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire, he confirms that kobolds infest Fargodeep Mine. He is not surprised and prepares to recruit fighters to confront them.
faq.q: What happens once you reach Goldshire?

sections.body: Kobolds have spread beyond Northshire Valley and the abbey grounds. With a tracking kit, you follow their trail to learn where they gather. Your report will help Goldshire prepare for threats across Elwynn Forest.
sections.title: Tracking the Vermin

sections.body: The tracks run southwest from Northshire and across Elwynn Forest toward Fargodeep Mine. Marshal Dughan commands Goldshire's garrison and already knows the mine is heavily infested with kobolds. Your report confirms the threat, and the mine remains overrun.
sections.title: The Fargodeep Connection

summary: Kobolds are moving from Northshire Valley toward Elwynn Forest. You follow their trail with a tracking kit and report what you find to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire.
